newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKISH SHARES AND VOLUME JUMP.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH SHARES AND VOLUME JUMP.

text.p: Istanbul shares extended morning gains sharply in afternoon buying on Wednesday amid strong liquidity inflow and expectations of a new government to replace the ruling Islamist-led coalition, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 .XU100 closed 42 points, or 2.76 percent higher at 1,565. It was up 0.92 percent in the first session. Trade volume jumped to 34.06 trillion lira from Tuesday's 19.90 trillion.
